name: qr-to-windows-11
description: Scan QR codes on your phone, receive them instantly on your Windows 11 desktop.

scripts.dev:server: npm run build:types && npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:types && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:types && npm run dev -w apps/desktop
scripts.build:server: npm run build:types && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:types && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:types && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:server && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
